title: Bolsonaro and Lula Outline Contrasting Proposals on Violence, Corruption, and Economy Ahead of Runoff
detail: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula have outlined sharply contrasting proposals on violence, corruption, and the economy as they intensify campaigning ahead of Brazil's presidential runoff. The policy clash underscores the ideological stakes of the second round.

title: Flávio Bolsonaro Secures Endorsement from Third-Place Candidate, Boosting Runoff Position Against Lula
detail: Brazil's Flávio Bolsonaro secured the endorsement of the third-place presidential candidate, consolidating right-of-center support and strengthening his position heading into the runoff against Lula. The endorsement could shift undecided voters in Bolsonaro's favor.
